hero.title: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
hero.description: An IMF analysis found that more than half of tokenized stock trading happens outside U.S. market hours, though the roughly $2.3 billion market remains more volatile and less liquid than traditional equities.
